sections.name: intro
sections.note: ambient: rain/insects, kalimba, drone; faint ~126 BPM tick pulse (not truly unmetered); low impact at 6.64; breathy vocal pickup from ~12.0

sections.name: verse1
sections.note: whispered verse, sparse percussion, sub hits every other bar

sections.name: build1
sections.note: cello ostinato / timpani / riser; accelerating figures in last 2 bars

sections.name: silence1
sections.note: instrument silent; only vocal: inhale 43.29, "and time stops"

sections.name: drop1
sections.note: braam + 4-on-floor kick + distorted sub; "Rewind. Rewind." then pitched vocal chops ("hoots")

sections.name: verse3
sections.note: pulsing sub, toms; vocal enters on bar 39, texture thins at bar 41 (74.55)

sections.name: breakdown
sections.note: kalimba + low drone; low-brass hits on alternate bars (137.4/141.5/145.3); whispered verse-1 reprise from 147.3; full drop-out 149.0-151.1

sections.name: build3
sections.note: horror build, heartbeat kick, sustained choir; "Never stop."

sections.name: silence3
sections.note: hard cut (no tape stop): vocal "stop" alone 170.36-171.01, then true digital silence 171.03-171.25

sections.name: instrumental
sections.note: stripped outro: sub/braam on alternate bars (219.65, 223.40), pitched-down hoots

sections.name: end
sections.note: abrupt end: final low hit 227.12, sustained ~2 s, fades to near-silence by ~231.3

lines.text: The night before my dissertation defense,
I'm speeding down Lake Shore, I dreamt
a shadow chasing me I couldn't place
I pulled over, and men in shades and suits,
I reach for my ID to show … and I do,
With no warning I get shot … and time stops
Rewind.
Rewind.
And now I'm back on the road
sirens in my mirror …Reload.
A shadow chasing me like it's a race
I zigzag across the field of grass
they chase me and they're just too fast
With no warning I get shot … and time stops
Rewind.
Rewind.
The night before my dissertation defense,
I'm speeding down Lake Shore, I dreamt
a shadow chasing me I couldn't place
Never stop.
